networkAccess.reasoning: The panel talks to the Archetype API to sign you in, create a persona study for the selected prototype flow, run it and read its results. It sends the file and page names, the names of the screens on the path, the goal and the user description you type, and the prototype share link if you paste one. During a test, every step sends a screenshot of the screen a persona sees, its visible text and what can be clicked to Archetype and its AI model provider, so the persona can see and act on what you built.
